summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Cafe Ikigai Admin Management System. Backend APIs are functional but return empty data (expected for fresh system). Critical frontend issue found: admin dashboard routing is broken - authenticated admin users are redirected to homepage instead of admin dashboard.

Menu page displays 14 menu items with category filtering
